hero.title: File:Constantinople imperial district.png
hero.credit: Image:Constantinople center.svg. Translated and added more detail. Original source: W. Müller-Wiener, Bildlexikon zur Topographie Istanbuls (1977), p. 232
hero.description: The imperial district of Byzantine Constantinople, with the Great Palace and the approximate locations of its main buildings (based on literary descriptions), the Hippodrome, the Hagia Sophia and the surrounding structures. Surviving or excavated structures are in black, the conjectural outlines of structures in grey, and the shaded portion corresponds to the area occupied by the Sultanahmet Camii and other later structures.
